rationale: M59.A7 (#825) line round for the csharp lane. Every expected line is the line where the edge's TARGET is written, and the four traps this lane actually has are each pinned twice — once as the correct claim and once as the pre-fix shape in `forbidRelationships`. MEASURED (not reasoned) with script/m14/tmp/cs-line-shapes.ts and script/m14/tmp/cs-825-measure.ts, and on a 200-file corpus draw through script/m59/oracle-callsite.ts: BEFORE this round the lane emitted NO line at all (23,924 relationships, withLine 0). After stamping all twelve emit sites: 23,924 withLine, 23,558 consistent, 366 notCheckable, and 653 INCONSISTENT — every one of them a `contains` edge claiming the DECLARATION's start line, which for an attributed or wrapped declaration is a line the member's name is not written on (e.g. `[Parameter]` above the property, 4 of the samples). That is a defect the line round itself can introduce, and it is fixed structurally: `contains` is now stamped from the declaration's NAME node, and a declaration whose SYMBOL name the source never writes (a constructor named `constructor`, a destructor named `Finalize`) takes NO line — the state java's synthesised members and kotlin's data-class phantoms take, and the state the oracle's own phantom rule calls correct. AFTER: 23,924 relationships, 23,558 withLine, 23,558 consistent, 0 INCONSISTENT, 0 notCheckable, 366 noLine (all synthesised constructor names — disclosed, counted, and pinned here as `line_number: null`). SOURCE-SPELLING CORRECTION 2026-10-02: the type-level edges are pinned with the BARE type name as the relationship source (`Widget`, `Shape`, `Qualified`), not the namespace-qualified one (`Pin.Widget`, `Acme.Domain.Shape`, `Probe.Qualified`) these rows used to name. The analyzer publishes the bare name, and the hand-audited truth agrees: validation/m12/ground-truth/csharp.json (truthSource=manual_audit) records type-level rows with bare sourceIds such as `BaseService -> BaseService {extends}` and `BaseService -> IRepository {implements}`. The qualified spelling was a pin that could never match, which is why this fixture was RED. Only the source LABEL changed: the edge type, target, line_number and every `meta.*` constraint are untouched, and the `forbid` rows that carried the qualified spelling were vacuous before (no edge ever had that source) and are now ACTIVE. Mutant csharp/drop-implements-edge and csharp/iface-base-extends-fabrication were unobservable for exactly this reason.
